thread.title: UPDATE: All 30 Dow company stocks drop, as UnitedHealth lops over 100 points off Dow's price

author: morningstar.com
title: UPDATE: All 30 Dow company stocks drop, as UnitedHealth lops over 100 points off Dow's price
text:
Shares of all 30 Dow Jones Industrial Average companies fell in premarket trade Tuesday, with Dow futures pointing toward the biggest point decline for the blue-chip barometer in over five months. The biggest weight on the Dow was UnitedHealth Group Inc.'s stock (UNH), which plunged $16.66, or 6.7%, amid concerns over increased competition after Amazon.com Inc. (AMZN), Berkshire Hathaway Inc. (BRKA) and J.P. Morgan Chase & Co. (JPM) announced plans for a new company to improve their employees' health care (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/health-care-company-shares-drop-sharply-on-entry-by-amazon-berkshire-hathaway-and-jpmorgan-2018-01-30). That selloff would shave about 115 points off the Dow's price. Pfizer Inc. shares (PFE) fell 1.6%, erasing earlier gains of as much as 2.5% after the drug maker beat profit expectations (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/pfizer-shares-rise-after-q4-profit-revenue-beats-upbeat-guidance-2018-01-30); that would shave just about 4 points off the Dow. Dow futures were down 254 points. Among other decliners, shares of J.P. Morgan Chase shares fell 0.5%, McDonald's Corp. (MCD) lost 0.3% after reporting fourth-quarter results, Caterpillar Inc. (CAT) dropped 1.4% and Apple Inc. (AAPL) shed 1.2%.
-Tomi Kilgore; 1534ET
